comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Daemon side landed (fc7ea43 and before): Pane.finished_unseen = 10, PaneRequest.Seen = 10, not persisted across a daemon restart (decided), carried across a handoff. Stays open for the app side: the core's done becomes the fact and the app sends Seen (slot 1's L5).

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since the cut-over (a_2XJ1hqla3), a pane whose agent finished while no Muster window was open comes back idle, not done: done is computed in the core (crates/muster-core/src/attention.rs) from transitions it saw, and muster-daemon reports only four states, so there is nothing to adopt the way herdr's own done was adopted (Attention::first_seen). That is the moment something needs you. Decided (integrator): the daemon holds a per-pane finished-unseen fact, set when an agent goes from working to idle, cleared by a request the app sends when a focused window shows the pane (and when the agent works again); the app's done is that fact. It survives app restarts and covers several windows, which the app-side fold cannot. Daemon side and protocol first, then the core and shell. Must land before the cut-over reaches main.
title: done survives a window that was closed: the daemon records finished-and-unseen
